items.source:
Determine the first nested property separator in the
given property path, ignoring dots in keys (like "map[my.key]").
items.translation: 确定给定属性路径中的第一个嵌套属性分隔符，忽略键中的点（例如"map[my.key]"）。

items.source: propertyPath - the property path to check
items.translation: propertyPath - 要检查的属性路径

items.source: the index of the nested property separator, or -1 if none
items.translation: 嵌套属性分隔符的索引，如果没有则为 -1。

items.source:
Determine the canonical name for the given property path. Removes surrounding quotes from map keys:
map['key'] → map[key]
map["key"] → map[key]
items.translation:
确定给定属性路径的规范名称。 移除映射键周围的引号：
map['key'] → map[key]
map["key"] → map[key]

items.source: Determine the canonical names for the given property paths.
items.translation: 确定给定属性路径的规范名称。

items.source: Return the actual property name for the given property path.
items.translation: 返回给定属性路径的实际属性名称。

items.source: Check whether the given property path indicates an indexed or nested property.
items.translation: 检查给定的属性路径是否表示索引属性或嵌套属性。

items.source:
Determine whether the given registered path matches the given property path,
either indicating the property itself or an indexed element of the property.
items.translation: 确定给定的注册路径是否匹配给定的属性路径，即指示该属性本身或其索引元素。

items.source: propertyPath - the property path to determine the property name for (can include property keys, for example for specifying a map entry)
items.translation: propertyPath - 用于确定属性名称的属性路径（可以包含属性键，例如用于指定映射条目）

items.source: registeredPath - the registered path (potentially with index)
items.translation: registeredPath - 已注册的路径（可能包含索引）

items.source: propertyPath - the property path (typically without index)
items.translation: propertyPath - 属性路径（通常不包含索引）

items.source: propertyName - the bean property path
items.translation: propertyName - 属性路径

items.source: propertyNames - the bean property paths (as array)
items.translation: propertyNames - 属性路径（作为数组）

items.source: the actual property name, without any key elements
items.translation: 实际的属性名称，不包含任何键元素。

items.source: whether the path indicates an indexed or nested property
items.translation: 该路径是指向索引属性还是嵌套属性

items.source: whether the paths match
items.translation: 路径是否匹配

items.source: the canonical representation of the property path
items.translation: 属性路径的正则表示形式

items.source:
the canonical representation of the property paths
(as array of the same size)
items.translation: 属性路径的正则表示形式（作为相同大小的数组）

items.source: Utility methods for classes that perform bean property access according to the PropertyAccessor interface.
items.translation: 用于执行根据PropertyAccessor接口定义的 Bean 属性访问的实用方法。

items.source: Determine the canonical name for the given property path.
items.translation: 确定给定属性路径的规范名称。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller
